parameters.jsCode: const body=$json.body??$json;const headers=$json.headers??{};const rawJobId=String(body.job_id||$json.job_id||'');const jobId=/^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$/.test(rawJobId)?rawJobId:'';const rawBody=JSON.stringify(body).replace(/'/g,"''");const missing=[];for(const f of ['project_name','brief_text','created_by']){if(!body[f]) missing.push(f);}return [{json:{...body,job_id:jobId,agent_secret:headers['x-agent-secret']||headers['X-Agent-Secret']||'',body_sql:rawBody,missing,is_valid:missing.length===0}}];

parameters.query: =WITH payload AS (SELECT '{{$json.body_sql}}'::jsonb AS body), client_upsert AS (INSERT INTO client_profiles (client_code,client_name) SELECT body->>'client_code',COALESCE(NULLIF(body->>'client_name',''),body->>'client_code') FROM payload WHERE NULLIF(body->>'client_code','') IS NOT NULL ON CONFLICT (client_code) DO UPDATE SET client_name=EXCLUDED.client_name,updated_at=now() RETURNING id), job_insert AS (INSERT INTO content_jobs (external_job_ref,client_profile_id,project_name,brief_text,requested_outputs,status,created_by) SELECT NULLIF(body->>'external_job_ref',''),(SELECT id FROM client_upsert LIMIT 1),body->>'project_name',body->>'brief_text',COALESCE(body->'requested_outputs','[]'::jsonb),'intake_complete'::job_status,body->>'created_by' FROM payload WHERE '{{$json.is_valid}}'='true' RETURNING id,status), task_insert AS (INSERT INTO content_tasks (job_id,task_type,task_key,status,input_payload) SELECT id,'intake','intake','completed',(SELECT body FROM payload) FROM job_insert), event_insert AS (INSERT INTO content_events (job_id,event_type,status_to,message,metadata) SELECT id,'job_created',status,'Job created through supervisor API',jsonb_build_object('source','api_create_job') FROM job_insert) SELECT (SELECT id::text FROM job_insert) AS job_id,(SELECT status::text FROM job_insert) AS status,'{{$json.is_valid}}'='true' AS valid;
